appDescription: A stargazing app for a parked car that shows tonight's sky and tells children's stories about stars and constellations.

functions.name: DESCRIBE_SKY_OBJECT
functions.description: Describes a star, planet, the Moon or a constellation and tells its story. Used when the user asks what a star is or wants to hear about it.

name.description: Name of the star, planet or constellation, such as 직녀성, 목성 or 오리온자리. Empty when the user means the one selected on the screen.

functions.name: FIND_SKY_OBJECT
functions.description: Turns the sky view toward a star, planet, the Moon or a constellation and tells where it is in the sky now.

name.description: Name of the star, planet or constellation to find, such as 북극성, 화성 or 카시오페이아자리.

functions.name: TELL_CONSTELLATION_STORY
functions.description: Shows and reads aloud a children's story about constellations.
